label: Homebrew
headline: Homebrew Cheat Sheet
description: Quick reference for Homebrew — the macOS package manager. Install formulae, manage casks, tap repositories, and keep everything up to date.

items.name: Install Xcode tools
items.definition: Install the Xcode Command Line Tools — required before installing Homebrew.

items.name: Install Homebrew
items.definition: Download and run the official Homebrew installer.

items.name: Check version
items.definition: Display the currently installed version of Homebrew.

items.name: Help
items.definition: Show general Homebrew help and a list of available commands.

items.name: Command help
items.definition: Show detailed help for a specific subcommand (e.g. brew help install).

items.name: Doctor
items.definition: Check your system for potential Homebrew problems and suggest fixes.

items.name: Install
items.definition: Download and install a package (formula).

items.name: Uninstall
items.definition: Remove an installed package.

items.name: Reinstall
items.definition: Uninstall and re-install a package from scratch.

items.name: Info
items.definition: Show details about a package — version, dependencies, install path, options.

items.name: List installed
items.definition: List all currently installed formulae.

items.name: List versions
items.definition: Show all installed versions of a specific package.

items.name: Search
items.definition: Search available formulae and casks by name or keyword.

items.name: Search all
items.definition: List every available formula and cask in all tapped repositories.

items.name: Update
items.definition: Fetch the latest version of Homebrew and all formula definitions.

items.name: Outdated
items.definition: List all installed packages that have a newer version available.

items.name: Upgrade all
items.definition: Upgrade all installed packages to their latest versions.

items.name: Upgrade one
items.definition: Upgrade a specific package to its latest version.

items.name: Pin
items.definition: Lock a package at its current version — it will be skipped by brew upgrade.

items.name: Unpin
items.definition: Remove the version lock, allowing the package to be upgraded again.

items.name: Link
items.definition: Symlink a formula's binaries into /usr/local so they are on your PATH.

items.name: Unlink
items.definition: Remove symlinks for a formula without uninstalling it — useful when switching versions.

items.name: Switch version
items.definition: Relink an already-installed older version of a package.

items.name: List taps
items.definition: Display all currently tapped third-party repositories.

items.name: Tap
items.definition: Add a GitHub-hosted tap (e.g. brew tap hashicorp/tap).

items.name: Tap with URL
items.definition: Add a tap from a custom Git URL instead of GitHub.

items.name: Untap
items.definition: Remove a tapped repository and all its formulae.

items.name: Enable casks
items.definition: Tap the official cask repository to enable GUI app installation.

items.name: Install cask
items.definition: Install a macOS GUI application (e.g. brew install --cask firefox).

items.name: Uninstall cask
items.definition: Remove an installed macOS application.

items.name: Reinstall cask
items.definition: Remove and re-install a GUI application.

items.name: List casks
items.definition: List all installed casks (GUI apps).

items.name: Search casks
items.definition: Search only casks by name or keyword.

items.name: Cleanup all
items.definition: Remove old versions of all installed packages and clear the download cache.

items.name: Cleanup one
items.definition: Remove old versions of a specific package only.

items.name: Dry run
items.definition: Preview what would be removed by cleanup without actually deleting anything.

items.name: Remove cache
items.definition: Delete all cached downloads regardless of age.
